app.tagline: Preserve the past. Share the future.
app.eyebrow: Preserve the past. Share the future.

language.label: Language
language.title: Make it yours
language.description: Choose your interface language. Your preference is saved on this device.

library.title: My library
library.description: Your games and preservation files on this computer.
library.emptyDescription: Choose files or folders to start your local collection.
library.importDescription: Choose your game files or a folder. Originals stay in place. Nothing is shared until you choose to share it.
library.manifestHint: JSON exports contain catalog hashes and relative paths. Choose a new filename; existing files are preserved.
library.loadedScope: Search, platform filters and totals apply to loaded items only. Load more to include the rest of your collection; indexed size is not deduplicated disk usage.
library.searchPlaceholder: Search titles shown in your library…
library.noMatches: No shown collections match your search.
library.metadataDetails: About these files and their condition
library.exportHint: Optional: create a portable package, sharing references or a file list. This does not start sharing or publish to a community.

tasks.title: Activity
tasks.description: Follow the games you add and the files you check.
tasks.emptyDescription: Imports and integrity checks will appear here.

settings.title: Your workspace, your way.
settings.description: Choose your language, save your local library, or restore a reviewed backup.

runtime.preview: Preview · open the desktop app to use your files
runtime.unavailable: Desktop backend unavailable. Restart the application to retry.

errors.ipcUnavailable: Open the desktop app to use this feature.
errors.contractMismatch: The interface and backend versions are incompatible. Restart with a matching build.
errors.invalidResponse: The backend returned an invalid response.
errors.databaseUnavailable: The local database is unavailable. Restart the app and try again.
errors.databaseTaskFailed: The database operation could not finish.
errors.invalidArgument: Check the supplied values and try again.
errors.notFound: The requested item was not found.
errors.taskNotCancellable: This task cannot be cancelled in its current state.
errors.capabilityUnavailable: This feature is unavailable in the current backend.
errors.sourceUnavailable: A source is empty, unavailable, unsupported, or contains a symbolic link/junction. Check it and select again.
errors.sourceChanged: A file changed during hashing. Close programs using it and select again.
errors.importLimitExceeded: Selection limit exceeded: up to 100 sources, 100,000 files, and 128 folder levels per import.
errors.manifestInvalid: The collection cannot be represented by manifest v1. Check its metadata and relative paths.
errors.manifestVersionUnsupported: This manifest version is unsupported. Use a compatible Game4 build.
errors.manifestWriteFailed: The manifest could not be saved. Choose an unused .json filename in a writable folder.
errors.backupInvalid: This file is not a valid Game4 library backup, violates catalog constraints, or exceeds the 64 MiB / 500,000-record limit.
errors.backupVersionUnsupported: This backup or database schema version is unsupported. Use a compatible Game4 build.
errors.backupWriteFailed: The backup could not be written. Choose an unused .json filename in a writable folder; restoration also requires space for a recovery copy.
errors.libraryBusy: Wait for imports, integrity checks and package exports to finish, then try again.
errors.restoreStale: The restore preview expired or the catalog changed. Select the backup again to review it.
errors.restoreFailed: Restoration could not finish. The current catalog was preserved; any recovery file remains available.
errors.verificationLimitExceeded: This item exceeds the verification limit of 500,000 registered copies.
errors.packageInvalid: This is not a valid Game4∞ v1 package.
errors.packageVersionUnsupported: This package version is not supported. Update Game4∞ to read it.
errors.packageWriteFailed: The package could not be saved. Choose a new .g4 filename and check permissions and free space.
errors.packageIntegrityFailed: A file is missing, unreadable or does not match its reference hash/size. Verify the sources or choose another package.
errors.packageLimitExceeded: This package exceeds supported limits (100,000 files, 1 TiB of payload, or metadata limits).
errors.g4eInvalid: This is not a valid supported .g4e descriptor or torrent reference.
errors.g4eLimitExceeded: The descriptor, torrent or source collection exceeds supported limits.
errors.g4eIntegrityFailed: The original files or selected torrent do not match their reference identities. Originals were not repaired or modified.
errors.g4eWriteFailed: References could not be saved. Choose a new .g4e filename and check permissions and free space. A new torrent companion may remain after a late write failure.
errors.torrentInvalid: This torrent is malformed or uses unsupported metadata. This preview accepts regular public BitTorrent v1 files without padding.
errors.transferLimitExceeded: Transfer limits reached (4 active sessions, 64 session records, 1,024 files or 1 TiB per torrent).
errors.transferFailed: The transfer could not be started or continued. Check sources, free space, port availability and peer connectivity. Any new partial download folder is kept.
errors.transferUnavailable: Transfers or their saved state are unavailable. Local Library operations remain available.
errors.storageUnavailable: A storage folder or its saved settings are unavailable. Check Storage folders in Settings; reconnect the drive or choose another folder.

backup.title: Save and restore your library
backup.description: Save a complete catalog backup, including metadata, hashes, paths, and task history. Game files and interface preferences are not included.
backup.privateData: Backups contain private local paths and notes. Keep them in a trusted place. Restored copies require a new integrity check.
backup.restored_one: Library restored: {{count}} item. Previous catalog saved in database/backups as {{recovery}}.
backup.restored_other: Library restored: {{count}} items. Previous catalog saved in database/backups as {{recovery}}.
backup.replaceWarning: Restoring replaces the current catalog. A recovery copy is saved first. Game files remain untouched. Wait for imports to finish before continuing. This also replaces the historical archive, artwork, favorites and collections. Older backups contain no historical archive.
backup.confirmReplacement: I understand that this backup will replace my current library.

integrity.title: File condition
integrity.scope: Checks all registered copies of this item’s content, including copies in other items. Does not scan for new files.
integrity.issues: Problems found. Review the counts below.
integrity.lastChecked: Latest observation: {{date}}. Files may have changed since.
integrity.neverChecked: Files have not been checked again since import.
integrity.completed: Check completed. Review integrity observations in the Library for matching, changed, missing or inaccessible copies.

packages.title: Game4∞ packages
packages.description: Create a portable .g4 from a Library item, or open one to verify every included file.
packages.creating: Creating .g4: reading and checking original files. Large collections can take a while. Keep the app open.
packages.reading: Reading package and verifying SHA-256 for every file. Large packages can take a while.
packages.verified: All included file sizes and SHA-256 hashes match the manifest. This checks consistency, not publisher authenticity.
packages.readOnly: Package inspected. No files were extracted, executed or imported into the Library.

ever.title: Sharing references (.g4e)
ever.description: Open a .g4e to read its information and download links. This does not download any files.
ever.exportLabel: Export sharing references for {{title}} without converting originals
ever.creating: Checking original SHA-256 and creating torrent pieces. Originals stay in place; no payload copy or .g4 is created.
ever.shareHint: Send both saved files or the download link to someone else. Keep the game sharing in Game4∞ so others can download it. Saving references alone does not share the files.
ever.descriptorOnly: Descriptor valid. Referenced torrent metadata, source availability and content have not been verified by this open action. No network connection was made.
ever.g4epGeometry: 8 data + 4 parity per group · {{groups}} groups · {{fragments}} fragments
ever.g4epReadOnly: Reconstruction metadata inspected. No fragment was downloaded and the original file was not verified or reconstructed.
ever.g4epSigned: The included digital signatures are cryptographically valid.
ever.g4epTrust: Confirm the signer fingerprint through a trusted channel. A valid signature alone does not identify the expected publisher.

transfers.title: My transfers
transfers.description: Follow downloads and sharing. Pause or resume whenever you need.
transfers.connectionDescription: Connect over IPv4 TCP using an initial peer, optional DHT or selected HTTP/HTTPS/UDP trackers. Local discovery and automatic router port mapping remain off.
transfers.exposure: Starting a seed or download opens a network session and can expose your IP to peers. Downloads also upload received pieces. A completed download stops by default, or continues seeding if you explicitly enable it.
transfers.sourceHint: Share files from your library without moving or converting them. Keep the app open while sharing.
transfers.noSource: Add your games to the library before sharing.
transfers.port: Listening TCP port (0 chooses an available port)
transfers.importHint: Choose a .torrent file or paste a download link below. You will review the files before downloading.
transfers.outputHint: Choose a parent folder next. Game4∞ creates a new download subfolder and never overwrites existing files. Stopping keeps received data.
transfers.empty: Your downloads and shared games will appear here. Nothing starts automatically.
transfers.preparing: Preparing files or updating the session. Large source checks may take a while.
transfers.listening: Listening port: {{port}}. Use this computer’s reachable IP plus this port on the other PC.
transfers.dht: Enable DHT for the next network action
transfers.dhtHint: DHT contacts the public UDP network and can publish your info hash and IP. It needs reachable peers and does not bypass NAT or firewalls. Existing sessions keep their original setting.
transfers.magnetHint: Reviewing a link connects to other participants to find the file list. Downloading starts only after you choose a folder.
transfers.resolving: Finding the file list… No game files are downloading yet.
transfers.useTrackers: Use the listed trackers for the next action
transfers.trackerHint: Review imported addresses before enabling them. Up to 16 trackers, 2,048 characters per URL and 4,096 total. Enabled trackers are contacted on network actions and included in generated magnets/torrents. Trackers receive your IP, info hash and transfer counters; URLs may contain private passkeys. No default public tracker is added.
transfers.keepSeedingHint: Optional: help others download this game. Leave the app open to keep sharing.
transfers.connected: Connected peers: {{peers}} · Seeders: {{seeders}} · Leechers / other peers: {{leechers}}
transfers.availabilityFull: Remote availability: {{count}} connected peers advertise a complete copy.
transfers.availabilityUnknown: Remote availability is undetermined. No connected seeder has advertised a complete copy; partial peers may still provide all pieces together.
transfers.peerScope: Counts describe this session, not the entire swarm. Other peers include incomplete copies and peers not yet classified. Advertised availability does not authenticate or verify their bytes.
transfers.metricsUnavailable: Speed and connections appear while the transfer is active.
transfers.availabilityFull_one: Remote availability: {{count}} connected peer advertises a complete copy.
transfers.availabilityFull_other: Remote availability: {{count}} connected peers advertise a complete copy.
transfers.persistenceHint: Progress is saved on this computer. After reopening the app, choose Resume to continue.
transfers.noMatches: No saved transfers match this filter.
transfers.liveScope: Connected participants in this transfer, updated about every second.
transfers.staleMetrics: Update unavailable. Byte totals and progress are last known; live speeds and peer counts are hidden.
transfers.limitsHint: 0 = unlimited. Otherwise use at least 16 KiB/s (1 KiB = 1,024 bytes). Limits apply per transfer to payload, allow short bursts and exclude protocol/discovery overhead. Multiple transfers each have their own allowance.
transfers.savedLimitsHint: Apply to this session now and save for resume. Does not start or resume a transfer. In-flight requests can briefly use the previous allowance.
transfers.referenceHint: Optional: prepare a download link or torrent file to send to someone else. You still need to start sharing to make the files available.
transfers.sharingNotice: Sharing connects to other people and reveals your IP address to them. Nothing is sent before you start.
transfers.permissionHint: Share only games and materials you are allowed to distribute.
transfers.downloadNotice: During a download, received parts can also be sent to other participants. They can see your IP address.
transfers.startedHint: Follow progress, change speed limits or pause from My transfers.
transfers.findParticipants: Find participants on the public network (DHT)
transfers.discoveryConsent: Optional. When you review or start a download, this contacts the public network and can expose your IP and download identifier.
transfers.connectionNeeded: To find the files, enable public discovery above or configure a direct connection.
transfers.copyManually: Link selected. Press Ctrl+C to copy.
transfers.linkHint: Send this link to someone else and keep sharing. Selected tracker addresses can be included; check before sending.

dashboard.title: Welcome to Game4∞
dashboard.description: A place to preserve your games and share their future.
dashboard.heroTitle: The game lives on with you.
dashboard.heroText: Keep a copy. Share what you can. Help video game history reach the next generation.
dashboard.scope: Library metrics cover the first 50 catalog items; sizes count each item, not unique disk usage.
dashboard.partial: More items are available in the Library.
dashboard.preview: Desktop preview. Open Game4∞ to load your local data.
dashboard.emptyText: Add game files or a folder. This keeps a local record without uploading anything.
dashboard.noActivity: Your imports and integrity checks will appear here.
dashboard.activityScope: Showing up to 5 of the latest 50 tasks.
dashboard.originalsText: Index and share without mandatory conversion.
dashboard.integrityText: Check your files against the records in your library.
dashboard.networkText: Saved transfers reopen paused. You decide when to resume.
dashboard.transferScope: Current saved sessions. No network sessions are started by this dashboard.

download.title: Download games
download.description: Use a link, torrent or archive reference. Review the files before downloading.

share.title: Share my collection
share.description: Help someone else keep a copy. Choose a game from your library to share.

community.title: Community
community.description: Explore the community catalogs you keep locally.
community.notAvailable: Communities are planned and are not available in this version. Joining, publishing, game discovery and community catalogs will be added in future releases.
community.catalogsText: Groups will organize their own collections and exchange open .g4lib catalogs.
community.storiesText: Preserve manuals, authorized artwork, versions and the stories behind each game.
community.guardiansText: Future Guardians can choose to help keep authorized collections available. Storage and sharing will always be your choice.
community.nowText: Organize your local collection, check its files and exchange games you are allowed to share using links or torrents. No community account is needed.

journeys.title: What would you like to do?
journeys.downloadText: Have a link or torrent? Review the files and choose where to save them.
journeys.shareText: Add your games to your library and choose what you want to make available.
journeys.communityText: Explore community catalogs you import and keep on this computer.

storage.title: Storage folders
storage.description: Choose where download and save dialogs open. You can still choose another destination each time.
storage.downloadsHint: Initial folder when you confirm where to save a new download. Each download gets its own subfolder.
storage.exportsHint: Initial folder for .g4 packages, .g4e sharing references, torrents and file lists.
storage.backupsHint: Initial folder for saving a catalog backup. Game files are not included in that backup.
storage.notSet: No default selected · choose each time
storage.missing: Folder unavailable. Reconnect the drive, choose another folder or clear this default.
storage.resetDone: Default cleared. Files and folders were kept.
storage.internal: Where Game4∞ keeps its internal data
storage.internalHint: The catalog, transfer history and preferences stay here. Game4∞ manages this location; changing the folders above does not move it.
storage.existingHint: Existing files, library originals and ongoing downloads stay in their current locations. No sharing starts when you choose a folder.

associations.readOnly: Read-only preview. Nothing was extracted, executed, imported, downloaded or shared.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyText: Completed actions and activity updates will appear here.
notifications.scope: Up to 30 notifications from this app session. Kept on this screen only, without system alerts or sound.
notifications.importStarted: Adding your files. You can follow progress in Activity.
notifications.importComplete: Files added to your library. Nothing was shared.
notifications.checkStarted: Checking your files. You can keep using the app.
notifications.filesChecked: File check finished. Review the results in your library.
notifications.taskFailed: An activity could not finish. Open Activity to see what happened.
notifications.sharingStarted: Sharing started. Keep the app open to make your files available.
notifications.downloadStarted: Download started. Follow it in Transfers.
notifications.downloadComplete: Download complete: {{name}}. Files have not been executed or imported.
notifications.transferFailed: Transfer needs attention: {{name}}. Open Transfers for details.
notifications.transferPaused: Transfer paused. Received files were kept.
notifications.transferStopped: Transfer stopped. Received files were kept.
notifications.transferForgotten: Transfer removed from the list. Files were kept.
notifications.transferUpdated: Transfer updated. Check its current status.
notifications.referencesSaved: Sharing references saved. This does not start sharing.
notifications.linkReady: Download link ready. Sharing starts only when you choose it.
notifications.torrentSaved: Torrent file saved. This does not start sharing.
notifications.libraryRestored: Library restored. Review your files before sharing.
notifications.packageChecked: Package inspected and included file hashes verified.
notifications.referencesChecked: Sharing references inspected. No download was started.

feedback.previewText: Open the Game4∞ desktop app to load your collection and use local files.
feedback.transferFilterHint: Choose another status or clear the filter to see all saved transfers.

archive.heroDescription: Explore platforms, document releases and connect the files that keep their stories alive. Your archive works offline.
archive.importWarning: This adds a separate catalog snapshot. Existing records remain intact. References are untrusted; no download or sharing starts.
archive.imported: Catalog added locally. No transfer was started.
archive.editorHint: Only your local catalog changes. Original files stay untouched. Provide sources and permission for any artwork or distribution reference.
archive.noDescription: No description yet. Add historical information and its sources.
archive.noReleases: Add a platform release, then an edition and its technical versions.
archive.compatibilityHint: Commercial editions and technical revisions are separate. Updates and DLCs require an explicitly selected base revision of the same edition.
archive.noContentsHint: Start with a platform release and an edition, then register a base version. Updates and DLCs can be linked afterwards.
archive.originalsHint: Original files, preservation packages and references stay distinct. No conversion is required.
archive.linkHint: Choose an existing import and the exact content it belongs to. This links its hashes and local copies without duplicating bytes.
archive.noLocalItems: No matching local imports. Import your files in My Library first.
archive.noFilesHint: Historical metadata is useful on its own. Link existing local files or attach a Game4 Ever manifest when available.
archive.networkUnknown: A registered link is not evidence of online peers or complete copies. Live availability is shown only for active transfers.
archive.downloadHint: This reference will open in Downloads for review. You choose the destination and connection options before starting.
archive.rightsConfirmation: I have permission to obtain and use this content.
archive.preservationHint: Integrity, local presence and network availability are different observations. Verification describes a local copy at its last check, not a guarantee of long-term preservation.
archive.noVerification: No local verification observations are available.
archive.historyScope: These are the latest observations per copy. Activity keeps the existing verification task history.
archive.communityLocal: Community catalogs are local snapshots you choose to import. They can be consulted offline without a central account or server.
archive.catalogTrust: Publisher identity, licenses and metadata are declarations. This version imports unsigned snapshots and does not subscribe to remote updates.
archive.noCatalogs: No community catalogs imported yet. Choose Import catalog to add a .g4lib file.
archive.platformIntro: Initial categories are editable. Add other platforms at any time.
archive.noPlatformHistory: No historical description recorded. Add a sourced account of this platform.
archive.preservationUnknown: Preservation coverage: unknown. A complete historical title count has not been established.
archive.collectionsHint: Favorite titles, keep a personal reading list and group games from their Overview page.
archive.noGames: Make room for the next story.
archive.noGamesHint: No games match this view. Add a historical record or import a community catalog. Files are optional.
archive.previewTitle: Your archive lives on this device
archive.previewDescription: Open the desktop app to catalog games, store artwork and browse local community catalogs.

fields.title: Title
fields.authorized: I have permission to share this content

archive.title: Game Archive
archive.liveReferenceScope: Observations from sessions on this computer matching reference info hashes. Reading does not start connections.
archive.noMatchingTransfer: No local session matches these references. Network availability remains unknown.

platforms.description: Browse consoles, computers and their catalogs.
